title: 2 Thessalonians
author: Paul the apostle with Silvanus and Timothy.
historicalSetting: Paul corrects confusion about the day of the Lord and encourages steadfastness.
keyVerse: 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17 — "Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself... comfort your hearts and establish you."
christFocus: Second Thessalonians points to Christ as the returning Lord who judges evil, comforts His people, and establishes them in every good work.
outline: Correction about the day of the Lord — 2 Thessalonians 2
